subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II package + bridge letter — audit window confirmation
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@greenfieldhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II package + bridge letter — audit window confirmation

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick intro call earlier. To move forward with your vendor review, can you confirm the documents Greenfield needs to complete the procurement checklist? Our usual initial bundle for SOC 2 Type II includes:

- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering the test period
- Bridge letter (if the report date is outside your desired window)
- Control narratives or high-level control matrix (DOCX/PDF)
- Sample telemetry extracts (logs) or presigned access to a small slice of logs (CSV)
- Key management & encryption summary and KMS provider statement
- Change management evidence (ticket ID examples, approval artifacts)
- Incident response timeline (recent incidents redacted)

We can share the package via one of the following secure options — please indicate preference and an email to grant access to:
- S3 presigned bundle (expiring link)
- SFTP dropbox with temporary credentials
- Shared Drive with viewer-only link (DLP on)
Attached is a short matrix showing what we recommend you review first and a stub for presigned transfer instructions.

Question on audit window: can you confirm the period you need the report to cover? For example, many customers request coverage through 2027-05-31 (our latest Type II run) or will accept the prior 12‑month period ending 2026-12-31 if that fits procurement timelines. If the report date doesn't exactly cover your requested window we provide a bridge letter that calls out scope/coverage and the next report date.

Suggested next steps:
1) Reply with preferred transfer method and the best contact for access.
2) Confirm the audit window you require (start/end).
3) If needed, let us know if your security team prefers an initial shortlist of 3 artifacts to review first — we can expedite those.

One-line canned replies you can reuse (examples below) — tell me which you'd like me to send to the Greenfield security distribution and procurement: see templates in body.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_request_matrix.xlsx, presigned-transfer-instructions.txt
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II package + bridge letter — audit window confirmation

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear list. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Can you confirm the exact date range covered by your most recent Type II report? Procurement typically needs an unbroken 12 month period; if your test period ended 2027-05-31 that would be ideal.
- For the presigned method: we prefer an expiring S3 link. Please confirm retention — we only need short-term access (48–72 hours) and a manifest of filenames.
- Does the bridge letter explicitly state that controls remained in place after the report end date until the current date (if applicable)? Procurement/legal need that language spelled out.

Also, what's your expected SLA to turn these items around? Our procurement deadline is July 8. If you can get a shortlist of 3 artifacts and the report/bridge letter by next week that would keep us on track.

Elena
Information Security, Greenfield Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II package + bridge letter — audit window confirmation

Elena — thanks, great questions. Quick answers inline: 

- Our latest Type II report test period: 2026-06-01 through 2027-05-31. We can provide the signed PDF (cosigned by our auditor) plus a short control matrix mapping the inclusion of common HIPAA-adjacent controls.
- Presigned S3 is fine — we'll issue a single presigned manifest with an expiry of 72 hours by default. If you need 48 hours instead we can shorten it. The manifest will list filenames and hashes (SHA256).
- Bridge letters: we offer two flavors 
  * "Coverage bridge" — confirms scope and that controls remained materially the same after the report end date through a specified bridge date.
  * "Snapshot bridge" — short statement that the report provides the basis for current controls but does not assert ongoing testing past the report date.

For procurement timeline: we can provide the report PDF + bridge letter + three priority artifacts (control narrative for encryption, sample auth logs for a 7‑day window, and the change management playbook extract) by 2027-06-25. Will that meet your July 8 deadline? If you confirm S3 presigned and who to send to, we'll generate links today.

Canned reply templates (pick one per stakeholder):

- Security team (short): 
  "We received Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (test period 2026-06-01 — 2027-05-31) and a bridge letter option. Please review the attached control matrix and sample logs (S3 presigned link) — flagged items: KMS overview, auth logs. Can you confirm this satisfies our control baseline?"

- Procurement (short): 
  "Redwood has provided the SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter; we have a presigned S3 bundle for review (48/72h). Please confirm next steps for contract review and whether additional attestation is required."

- Legal (short): 
  "Redwood's report includes auditor-signed Type II PDF and bridge letter. Legal: please review bridge language regarding ongoing control assertion and advise if added wording is needed for the agreement."

If those look good, I'll send the S3 presigned manifest to the indicated address once you confirm.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa and Ben to track any procurement / sales items.

Jonas

Jonas — thanks, that timeline works. Please proceed with: 
1) S3 presigned bundle (72h expiry) to elena.rossi@greenfieldhealth.com and procurement@greenfieldhealth.com.
2) Provide the "coverage bridge" letter (we prefer the explicit language that controls remained materially the same through 2027-06-15).
3) Send the three priority artifacts you listed by 2027-06-25.

Procurement will follow up with a DocuSign NDA later today; I copied Marissa for any commercial questions. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena
